description: Rokid Glasses AIUI Agent - tour watch: on a group tour, the main line is looking at the sights and the side line is the guide's meeting calls - register the meeting point by facing it, pick a meeting time, far-field listening passes guide announcements through a meeting-keyword gate (meeting/depart/board/roll-call/meeting point) and only meeting sentences are bannered, spoken once by keyword and saved as notes, everything else is only counted and discarded, and a due reminder points you back to the registered direction before meeting time. No speaker identification, no location navigation: the registered direction is only a direction you recorded, not a route. Session memory only, wiped on close.
name: tour-watch
